description: The bar chart, titled "Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2)", displays the accuracy of a model across three different datasets—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—measured against five different attributes: city, hobby, university, major, and birthdate. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, while the vertical axis represents accuracy, scaled from 0 to 90. For the Qwen2.5-7b-1M dataset, the accuracy values are approximately 90 for city, 89 for hobby, 87 for university, 91 for major, and 89 for birthdate. For the Internlm3-8b dataset, the accuracy values are approximately 72 for city, 76 for hobby, 55 for university, 65 for major, and 88 for birthdate. For the Qwen2.5-7b dataset, the accuracy values are approximately 3 for city, 4 for hobby, 3 for university, 4 for major, and 16 for birthdate. The chart shows that the Qwen2.5-7b-1M model generally achieves higher accuracy across all attributes compared to the other two models, while the Qwen2.5-7b model shows significantly lower accuracy across all attributes. The accuracy for the birthdate attribute is consistently high for the Qwen2.5-7b-1M and Internlm3-8b models, but is notably low for the Qwen2.5-7b model.
